<title level="1" right="Spell 4" pfs="Standard">
[Flicker](/Spells.aspx?ID=1532)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Teleportation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=156" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 332

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

**Deities**
[Black Butterfly](/Deities.aspx?ID=115), [Nethys](/Deities.aspx?ID=288), [Ng](/Deities.aspx?ID=98), [Phi Deva](/Deities.aspx?ID=301)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

You flicker quickly between your current plane and another. You gain resistance 5 to all damage, except force. At the end of each of your turns, you automatically teleport 10 feet in a random direction, as determined by the GM. You can Sustain the spell to teleport in this way.

---
**Heightened (+2)** The resistance increases by 3.
name: Flicker
